history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young, handsome man with dark, messy hair and white earbuds is taking a mirror selfie in a modern public restroom. He is wearing a plain black t-shirt. The background is a large mirror reflecting the restroom. The mirror is framed by a black, wire mesh ceiling feature and fluorescent strip lighting. Behind the man, the restroom walls are tiled with grey rectangular tiles and a black and white geometric pattern. A chrome faucet is visible in the lower left corner. The lighting is bright and slightly harsh, typical of a public restroom, creating a somewhat cool and utilitarian mood. The image is captured from a medium shot, focusing on the man's upper body and face, with the reflection showing the surrounding environment. The overall style is casual and contemporary.
